title: The Righteous and the Wicked: Responsibility for One's Own Sin
description: The word of the Lord came to Ezekiel, rejecting the proverb that fathers eat sour grapes while their children's teeth are set on edge. God illustrates with examples of a righteous man, his violent son, and that violent son's righteous son, showing that each person bears responsibility for their own sin. The one who sins shall die, but the wicked who turns from their ways shall live. God declares that He takes no pleasure in anyone's death and urges Israel to create for themselves a new heart and a new spirit: 'Turn and live!'
